description: Source code for the xprepare module of the LibXDiff library, implementing file differencing and comparison functions.

classes.name: xdlclass_t
classes.description: Represents a classified record with linked list structure, index, and length info.

classes.name: xdlclassifier_t
classes.description: Holds hash table and array structures for classifying file records during diff operations.

methods.name: xdl_init_classifier
methods.description: Initializes the classifier with hash table and record arrays.

methods.name: xdl_free_classifier
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the classifier.

methods.name: xdl_classify_record
methods.description: Classifies a record into the classifier, updating length counters and assigning hashes.

methods.name: xdl_free_ctx
methods.description: Frees context data for a file being processed.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_ctx
methods.description: Prepares the context for diffing by reading file data, classifying records, and initializing structures.

methods.name: xdl_free_env
methods.description: Frees environment data for diffing process.

methods.name: xdl_clean_mmatch
methods.description: Determines if a line should be discarded based on neighboring line actions and window limits.

methods.name: xdl_cleanup_records
methods.description: Removes records with no matches or potential for discard, optimizing diff process.

methods.name: xdl_trim_ends
methods.description: Trims matching records from the start and end of files to optimize diffing.

methods.name: xdl_optimize_ctxs
methods.description: Performs trimming and cleanup on diff contexts.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_env
methods.description: Main function to prepare environment for file diffing, initializing classifiers and contexts.
